interpretation: T31 hit AssertionError('majorant <= N') at dwarf N=1e4 because the KiSS-SIDM code's collision sampler requires enough particles per radial cell to estimate the local scattering rate. T27 confirmed r_core/r_s converges between N=1e4 and N=1e5 at the canonical halo, and the canonical KiSS-SIDM paper (Gurian & May 2025) reports convergence only at N=2e6. We hypothesise that the dwarf regime requires N>=1e5 for the assertion to clear. T38a/b tests this.
